payload: [qa/verify-committed] scripts/verify-fleet-commit-pathspec.sh is RED (exit 1, 6 FAIL lines) and ALL SIX are prose FALSE POSITIVES -- zero real bare-commit instructions, inspected line-by-line. That script IS the persisted AC-3 regression proof for FIX-COMMITCONVENTION-MANDATES-BARE-COMMIT-CONTRADICTS-LIVE-SWEEPGUARD-HARDBLOCK, so while it is red the fleet-wide pathspec claim has NO usable evidence. TWO ROOT CAUSES, both in the checker, not in the corpus. (a) ALLOWLIST LINE-NUMBER DRIFT -- the opt-IN allowlist keys are file:line pairs, which rot on every edit above them: docs/agents/developer/flow/main.md is allowlisted at :104 but the prose now sits at :105; docs/policies/dev-standards.md is allowlisted at :805 and :1465 but the prose now sits at :1428 and :2204. (b) FORWARD-ONLY LOOKAHEAD -- 3 never-allowlisted RULE-2.5 explanatory notes (docs/agents/market-watcher/flow/cycle.md:306, docs/agents/market-watcher/flow/eod.md:106, docs/agents/news-scout/flow/stage-log-notify.md:45) each sit IMMEDIATELY BELOW their own correctly-pathspec-scoped code fence and say so verbatim ("The trailing -- <path> ABOVE closes that gap"), but the script only scans LOOKAHEAD=10 lines FORWARD from the match and therefore never sees the pathspec that is 2-3 lines ABOVE. Suggested fix: add a symmetric backward lookbehind window (kills class b outright) and re-key the allowlist on a content fingerprint rather than a line number (kills class a permanently). Found during QA of FIX-SWEEPGUARD-BARE-COMMIT-REPEAT-AFTER-BLOCK-ROUTER-SESSION-20-WARNS; deliberately NOT absorbed into that row (different row, different AC) and NOT treated as a blocker there, since that row's AC-1/AC-2 were verified by direct call-site inspection rather than by this script.
